applications.name: Missing in Action - 3
applications.description: When a Buff on the Defender expires, a 3 seconds timer starts. If the Attacker strikes the Defender with a Heavy or Special Attack before the timer expires, the Defender is inflicted with a [k=glossary/falter]Falter[/k] Debuff for 5 seconds and the timer is removed. If the timer expires, the Attacker is Faltered instead.
applications.rawDescription: When a Buff on the Defender expires, a {2} seconds timer starts. applications.name: Debuff Synthesis - Stun/Bleed
applications.description: Whenever the Attacker applies a Bleed Debuff to the opponent while the Defender is suffering from a Stun Debuff, both Debuffs are consumed and the Defender is afflicted with a Poison Debuff dealing [16982bff]200%[-] of the Attacker's Attack as Direct Damage over 15 seconds, and reducing health recovery by 30%.
applications.rawDescription: Whenever the Attacker applies a Bleed Debuff to the opponent while the Defender is suffering from a Stun Debuff, both Debuffs are consumed and the Defender is afflicted with a Poison Debuff dealing [16982bff]{1}%[-] of the Attacker's Attack as Direct Damage over {2} seconds, and reducing health recovery by 30%.

applications.name: Energy Adoption: Lightning - 2
applications.description: The Defender has a 50% chance to inflict the Attacker with Shock each time the Defender is struck or the Attacker blocks an attack. These effects will not trigger while the Defender is suffering from a Poison Debuff.\nThe Defender also takes 100% reduced damage from Shock effects and gains a Regeneration Buff healing 1% of max health per second until the Shock expires.
applications.rawDescription: The Defender has a {1}% chance to inflict the Attacker with Shock each time the Defender is struck or the Attacker blocks an attack.
